# Repository Instructions

- Do not commit or push unless the user explicitly asks.
- When asked to commit, push, publish, or upload project changes to GitHub, follow the `github-push-guide` skill in `.agents/skills/github-push-guide/SKILL.md`.
- Split unrelated changes by project scope and use Conventional Commit messages.
- Never commit `.env` files, credentials, generated build output, dependency directories, or unrelated user changes.
